title: Test Covers KaTeX Operator-Symbol Style Pass-Probe
description: The frontend module shall have a test asserting that a katex-classed span with position:relative style is preserved.
rationale: KaTeX emits position:relative inline on single-symbol operator spans such as those produced by \int, \sum, and \prod. Without a test confirming this declaration passes the allowlist, a future allowlist change could strip it silently, breaking operator spacing and baseline alignment for integral and summation expressions.
